newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH C.BANK RESERVES DIP TO $12.633 BLN END-SEPT.
newsitem.headline: CZECH C.BANK RESERVES DIP TO $12.633 BLN END-SEPT.

text.p: Foreign exchange reserves of the Czech National Bank (CNB) dipped to $12.633 billion as of the end of September from $12.984 billion at the end of August, the CNB said in a statement.
CZECH FOREX RESERVES SEPT 1996 AUG 1996 SEPT 1995
Note. All figures are subject to revision and do not
include crown-denominated assets from trading activity with
non-residents, the CNB said. It said the change in reserve
results was due to exchange rate changes within the central
bank's mark/dollar basket to which the Czech crown is fixed
It said withdrawls from the SPT accounts and payments on
debt servicing were reflected in the results.
